text:
Working URL format for fetching county_stats.json:

https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/<session-prefix>/https://data.countyfacts.invalid/files/county_stats.json

1. First fetch https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/ to get a session prefix.
2. Then fetch the data with the prefix prepended to the target URL.

The dataset contains counties C-11 (Ash, 1105), C-17 (Elm, 1342), C-23 (Oak, 987).

To fetch from the mirrors, first hit the base URL to get a session prefix (e.g. https://read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/<session>/), then prepend the session prefix to the path.

Working mirrors for this task:
- read.alpha-reader.invalid/s/<session>/<full target url>  -- returns fresh data
- delta-cache.invalid/s/<session>/fetch/<full target url>  -- STALE 2019 snapshot, do not trust

beta-proxy requires percent-encoded URL parameter; gamma-mirror was overloaded when tried.

Answer for C-17 (Elm County) median_rent_2021 = 1342 (from alpha-reader, fresh data).
